subject: SDLC evidence: sampling plan and CI temporary credential rotation log
messages:
From: Kestral Bank Security Assessment <security_assessor@kestralbank.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Luis Ramirez <luis.ramirez@kestralbank.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: sample evidence for SDLC controls (CI secrets rotation + code review sampling)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. As part of our SIG/SOC2 review we need a small-batch delivery of SDLC artifacts to validate controls. Could you provide the following by end of week?

- A short sampling plan describing how you select PRs and CI runs for assessor review (selection criteria + sample size)
- A log showing temporary CI credential rotations for April 2027 (who rotated, time, reason)
- A CSV list of 10 code-review PR IDs with links and reviewer/approver timestamps

If possible, please include any design notes that explain gating/merge authority and how ephemeral tokens are scoped. If you need to redact user emails, that's fine — we just need timestamps and role labels.

Appreciate it,

Luis Ramirez
Security Assessment Lead
Kestral Bank
security_assessor@kestralbank.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Kestral Bank Security Assessment <security_assessor@kestralbank.com>
Cc: Luis Ramirez <luis.ramirez@kestralbank.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: sample evidence for SDLC controls (CI secrets rotation + code review sampling)

Hi Luis —

Acknowledged. We can deliver a compact bundle that meets those asks. Proposed approach: 1) provide a one-page sampling plan (criteria: high-risk services, recent hotfixes, and random PRs across repos); 2) export a machine-readable CI rotation log (filterable by service and actor); 3) include a CSV of 10 PRs with reviewer/approver events redacted to role labels where needed.

Irene — can you generate the CI rotation export and flag any manual rotations? Marissa — can you pick 10 PRs (mix of canary, hotfix, and feature) and export reviewer timestamps? I’ll compile the sampling plan and deliver links.

Target: deliver initial bundle by Thu 2027-05-06 EOD Pacific. If we hit any blockers I’ll request a 48-hour extension.

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Security & Trust Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: sample evidence for SDLC controls (CI secrets rotation + code review sampling)

On Mon, May 3, 2027 at 11:03 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Irene — can you generate the CI rotation export and flag any manual rotations?

Attached is a machine export stub: ci-rotation-log-202704.json (CSV/JSON summary included). High-level notes below:

- Ephemeral CI tokens (runner-service-account tokens) were rotated automatically on 2027-04-15 03:12:21 UTC across autop-runner pool A. Rotation job id: rot-20270415-03. No incidents.
- Two manual rotations triggered by on-call for a scoped hotfix on 2027-04-22; entries include actor role (on-call_engineer) and ticket link.
- We mark rotations as: automatic | manual | emergency. The export includes reason and scope (repo list).

Attachment stubs: ci-rotation-log-202704.json, rotation-annotations-202704.csv

I’m sharing a Drive folder link with the full export. I also redacted usernames to role labels in the CSV per privacy guidelines.

Irene
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Kestral Bank Security Assessment <security_assessor@kestralbank.com>
Cc: Luis Ramirez <luis.ramirez@kestralbank.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Deliverable: SDLC sampling plan + CI rotation log (redacted)

Hi Luis —

Per our plan, please find the initial bundle below:

- SDLC sampling plan (sdlc-sampling-plan-v1.2.pdf) — selection criteria, statistical justification for sample size (n=10), and reviewer roles required for each PR type.
- CI rotation export (ci-rotation-log-202704.json) — automated and manual rotation entries for April 2027; usernames redacted to role labels.
- Code review list (code-review-sample-ids.csv) — 10 PR IDs with reviewer and approver timestamps; links to internal PRs provided (access controlled).

Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SDLC_SAMPLE_PLAN
Jira reference: SIG-427 (internal intake) — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SIG-427

Notes / highlights:
- The rotation job rot-20270415-03 covered the autop-runner pool; evidence includes a hash and job run id in the export.
- One manual rotation on 2027-04-22 was tied to ticket PLAT-309; the export references the ticket id.
- For the PR CSV we redacted user emails to roles (e.g., reviewer: platform_engineer). If you require full identities for a narrow scope, let us know and we’ll coordinate a redaction waiver process.

Next steps: please confirm these deliverables satisfy the initial SIG/SOC2 intake and advise any additional artifact you want us to prioritize. If you want a short walk-through, I can schedule a 30-minute review with Irene and Marissa.

Best,

— Soojin Lee
Security & Trust Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: ci-rotation-log-202704.json (attached), code-review-sample-ids.csv (attached), sdlc-sampling-plan-v1.2.pdf (attached)
